posts.title: No Ephemerons in Ruby's WeakMap
posts.description: Let’s say you want to associate a property with an object, but you don’t want to write to the object directly, maybe for design reasons or logistical reasons. (What if the object is frozen and immutable?) You can use WeakMap for this, and the garbage collector is free to collect keys of the map: object = [] map = ObjectSpace :: WeakMap . new map [ object ] = [ object ] p map . member?(object) # =>
